title: FSL DualRegression

con_file.desc: Design contrasts for final cross-subject modelling with randomise

des_norm.desc: Whether to variance-normalise the timecourses used as the stage-2 regressors; True is default and recommended

design_file.desc: Design matrix for final cross-subject modelling with randomise

group_IC_maps_4D.desc: 4D image containing spatial IC maps (melodic_IC) from the whole-group ICA analysis

in_files.desc: List all subjects' preprocessed, standard-space 4D datasets

n_perm.desc: Number of permutations for randomise; set to 1 for just raw tstat output, set to 0 to not run randomise at all.

one_sample_group_mean.desc: perform 1-sample group-mean test instead of generic permutation test

out_dir.desc: This directory will be created to hold all output and logfiles

description: Wrapper Script for Dual Regression Workflow
